name: Watchdog Mailer
description: This module sends email about watchdog log entries.
project_description:
This lightweight module expands Drupal core's logging functionality by providing the ability to send email notifications of site errors and notices to an email address of your choice.

 The module's configuration allows you to select to receive all PHP notices and errors, logging from specific channels or all logging except from specific channels. You may also define a maximum number of emails the module may send per hour to prevent inbox flooding.
